name: norm
description: Claude Code plugin for activating Norm: Bland's super_norm custom agent over the first-class Bland MCP API.

bland_api_url.title: Bland API URL (optional)
bland_api_url.description: Optional. Defaults to production (https://api.bland.ai); only set this to point at a dev/staging server. Not a secret.

bland_api_key.title: Bland API key
bland_api_key.description: Your Bland API key from app.bland.ai. Stored locally in ~/.claude/settings.json (mode 0600). In the Desktop app, run /norm:setup to enter it via a native OS dialog (the plugin manager does not prompt for it).
